description: This file defines a PHP attribute class 'FirstClassTwigCallableReady' within the Twig templating engine. The class is used as a marker annotation to indicate nodes that can accept a 'TwigCallable' directly.

classes.name: FirstClassTwigCallableReady
classes.description: A marker attribute class indicating that nodes are ready to accept a TwigCallable instead of its name.
